name: real class accessors preserve collection assignments
source:
class Holder {map:Map<string,number>=new Map<string,number>();calls=0;get current():Map<string,number>{this.calls+=1;return this.map;}set current(v:Map<string,number>){this.calls+=1;this.map=v;}}
function main():void {const token:any=Holder;const h=new Holder();const a:any=h;const m=new Map<string,number>();const b:any=m;console.log(h.calls);a.current=b;console.log(a.current===b,h.map===m,h.calls);a.current.set("x",3);console.log(m.get("x"),h.calls);}
